ItemID: 1; Title: AmazonCommercial 10 Gallon Commercial Office Wastebasket, Blue, w/ Recycle Logo, 6-pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A six-pack of office recycling bins does not fit my recent repair and fabrication projects.
ItemID: 2; Title: AIRIC 3/8 inch Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Small Marine Grade Shrinking Cable Tube Dual Wall Adhesive Shrinkable Wire Wrap Tubes Roll, Fully Insulation (20 Feet Black Tubing, and 20 Feet Red Tubing); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Adhesive heat shrink would be useful for insulating and protecting wiring during my DIY repairs.
ItemID: 3; Title: Okebond Super Glue Clear Strong Repair (Blue OB-4700+1pcs); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I have been using adhesives and resin, and a quick-setting glue would complement those supplies for small repairs.
ItemID: 4; Title: Roll Pins, 65Mn Steel Roll Pin Assortment Set 360PCS 10 Sizes - 1/16, 2/25, 1/10, 1/8, 11/80, 5/32, 1/5, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8 Slotted Spring Pins for Home Improvement Automotive Repair and Machine Projects; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my repeated interest in fastener assortments and would give me more options for mechanical repairs.
ItemID: 5; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These would protect wiring through drilled holes and complement my drilling and fastening supplies, provided the sizes fit.
ItemID: 6; Title: 0.15 Inch Industiral Endoscope Camera ILIHOME 4.3'' IPS Screen Waterproof Drain Snake Camera 1080P HD Digital Borescope Inspection Camera with 6 LED Lights Sewer Camera for Automotive HAVC Pipeline; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a triple-lens Teslong inspection camera and do not currently see a reason to buy another.
ItemID: 7; Title: Realth Strong Neodymium Disc Magnets Round 1.18” x 0.12” 6 Pack Rare Earth Magnets Heavy Duty for Fridge Office Crafts Science Project (MC300306); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Magnets could be useful for workshop fixtures, but I would wait until I have a project needing this size.
ItemID: 8; Title: VDIAGTOOL V200 Automotive Circuit Probe Tester, 12V 24V Car Power Circuit Probe Kit, AC Voltage, DC Voltage, Diode Test, Resistance Check, Electrical System Test Tool, Short Finder; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like diagnostic tools, but I do not have a current automotive electrical troubleshooting need.
ItemID: 9; Title: AmazonCommercial Velvet Ropes Crowd Control Stanchions, 2-Pack, Gold; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Crowd-control ropes have no practical connection to the hands-on projects I am shopping for.
ItemID: 10; Title: AUTOAlkins 8" Heavy Duty Suction Cup to Lift Large Glass, Tile, Marble, Industrial Vacuum Suction Lifter with Handle for Glass Lifting & Replacement, 240 lbs Load Capacity (2 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently handling large glass panels or slabs, so this specialized lifting tool would go unused.
